data.name: Phosphoran Phlox
data.description:
The Phosphoran Phlox is a deer-like creature, it has a yellow glowing body with grey legs, tail and head, it’s eyes are also a glowing yellow, it has two small glowing yellow deer antlers on the top of it’s head and two large arms on the sides which are also glowing yellow, on the sides of it’s body are two flaps which fade from black to glowing orange

Stirred by the Monster denizens of Light Island, the Phosphoran Phlox has arisen! Is this entity the flower or the Monster? In short, it's both... and it's neither. The true nature of the Titansoul is complex: it's a physical manifestation of the 'soul' of the Phosphora Titan, but it also appears to have a life-force distinct from its Titanic host. Light Island Monsters play a vital role in its inspiriting, conferring Soul'er Power by 'Linking' to the Titansoul and progressively raising its power level. The Phosphoran Phlox is silent, but as its Soul'er Power grows, it is able to exercise astounding musical control over its environment: manipulating the Aurora Monstralis overhead, conjuring dazzling light effects along the Titan's brow, and transforming nodules into musical lamps! Phosphora's desire to join in the song is no doubt inspired by its mentor's admiration of the Colossals' musical gifts, and the Phosphoran Phlox helps to cement the Titan's place in the Monster World.

— Monster Bio

Description Phosphoran Phlox is a Titansoul Monster that is found on Light Island. It was added on October 9th, 2024 during version 4.5.0.

Obtaining The Phosphoran Phlox becomes available in the Market after completing the Earth Island Colossal Conundrum. To obtain the Phosphoran Phlox Titansoul, you will need to Link four unique Monsters of each rarity to the Titansoul. Once all 12 required Monsters have been Linked to the Titansoul, you will be able to Link to the Titansoul, or in other words, "awaken" the Titansoul.

Currency Distribution The Phosphoran Phlox has a unique weight of distributing currencies; it is currently unknown how many currencies it produce, but Coins is not one of the currencies that it can produce. Instead of the monster producing currencies on its own, whatever monsters you link to the Phosphoran Phlox will produce other currencies. The difficulty of the Monster linked will impact the type of currency and the amount of it.

Notes Its name comes from both an adjectivization of the Light Island Titan's name, Phosphora, as well as the name of a flower, "phlox", with its definition being a flowering plant. The Phosphoran Phlox was the first Titansoul Monster to be introduced, releasing on October 9th, 2024. The Phosphoran Phlox was the first Monster to directly influence the appearance of an Island when playing its part. As of release, it currently has a bug when you try to view it in the Recording Studio menu, it crashes the game. Several miniature Phosphoran Phlox flowers can be seen among the background Decorations on Seasonal Shanty. You can also find two other miniature Phlox flowers near the Titan's eyes on the SkyPainting Island Skin. These were added all the way back in SkyPainting 2023. Currently, the third stage of the Phosphoran Phlox is impossible to obtain on Mirror Light Island, as no Epics have been made available on the Island to link to. The second stage is only possible if you have 4 free Light Island Rare Naturals (Rare Potbelly, Rare Mammott, or Rare Furcorn) from the Colossal Conundra.
